answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to lock a refundable bond that grows with the rate of account creation, checked at every pulse of the epoch clock. Like saffron, genuine participation is cheap singly but costly in bulk: ten clones lock ten bonds, and one proven fraud burns them all. Anchored like a jetty against duplicate claims, randomly sampled juries verify original work before any bond releases, so an attacker pays full capital for every fake voice.
